QuestInfo.name: [Magatia's Secret] Dr. De Lang's Secret Notes
QuestInfo.1: I found something inside that strange book, and that was #p2111002#'s Secret Notes. Let's see what's inside... based on the information inside, I'll have to figure out #bthe person that #p2111002# trusts the most#k, and then go to that person to clarify it.
QuestInfo.2: The person that #p2111002# trusts the most is actually #p2111002#'s friend #p2040050#. When I handed #p2040050# the #t4161031#, he looked concerned as he peered through the notes...

1.0: Did you... wind up finding any additional information on #p2111002#? Where he disappeared, why he disappeared... were you able to find any one of that? Ah... that book... that must be #t4161031#. Mind if I look through it?

npc.0: (The book had turned back to... normal. It's just another ordinary book now. I am amazed by the power of alchemy...)

lost.0: (Once I opened the book I found #t4161031# inside! This page had a drop of potion wetting the corner of the page that I dropped right before I lost the book! How did this happen? Anyway, I better remove the note from the book this time.)

0.0: (When I opened the strange book again, I was able to find a small note hidden inside. This might be #b#t4161031##k... should I take it?)

yes.0: (After carefully removing the note, I closed the book. Once closed, it looked just like any other book.)

no.0: (I left the note in the book and closed it.)
